**Finding: compliant (GOVLAW) — no redline.**

Section 28 meets the preferred position in full:
- **§28.1** — New York law governs the Agreement and each dispute arising from it (with CISG excluded).
- **§28.2** — Exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, plus irrevocable submission to personal jurisdiction and waiver of venue/inconvenient-forum objections. The carve-out permitting temporary injunctive relief in another court is the customary one and does not undercut the exclusive merits forum.

No arbitration provision exists anywhere in the document, and §28.3's pre-filing executive escalation expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings, so it does not displace the court forum.
